result_text:
Promotions now carry an optional description, and it comes back in all the listings you named plus the code lookup. The full suite passes (609 tests, BUILD SUCCESS).

What changed:

- **`schema.sql`**: new nullable `description VARCHAR(200)` column on `promotion`.
- **`model/Promotion.java`**: `description` added as the last record component, null when a promotion has none.
- **`DataStore.java`**: the insert writes the description, and the six promotion queries (by code, active on date, active in region, by category, best for category, unused) select it and map it back. Product queries are untouched.
- **`service/PromotionService.java`**: new 6-argument `createPromotion(..., category, description)`. A null or blank description is stored as null. Descriptions over 200 characters are rejected with `IllegalArgumentException`. The existing 5-argument method delegates with no description, so the many current callers and `DemoScenario` are unchanged.
- **`PromotionTest.java`**: two new tests. One checks that "Summer sale on all hardware" appears in each listing and the code lookup. The other checks that a promotion without a description, or with a blank one, reports null.

Choices I made that you may want to change: the 200-character limit, blank treated as "no description", and the 5-argument overload kept rather than updating every caller. Demo data has no descriptions added. Nothing is committed; the `.claude/` directory was already untracked before I started.
